**Terence Allan Choy** was a Chinese-American toy designer who designed for Mattel from [1984](/wiki/1984) to 2005. He started as Senior Designer (1984-1985), Project Designer (1985-1987), then Senior Project Designer (1988-2005). He was the Project Manager for the Adult/Collector Division of Hot Wheels Racing, which included Formula 1, NASCAR and Rally products. He was responsible for the earliest Batmobile casting designs for Hot Wheels with the 100% Batmobiles Series which debuted in 2003 with the Dream Halloween 1989 Batmobile; made for charity. He was a designer for *The Simpsons* toy line in addition to his Hot Wheels portfolio. He was one of the designers for some of the vehicles for an ill-fated *He Man* movie, alongside a number of other Hot Wheels designers. Terry passed away on 7 April 2020 from cancer, aged 67.
